info.name: Inspect360 integration
info.summary: Nextcloud integration for Njordium Inspect360 — sign in with your Inspect360 email and password to bring TPRM data into your Nextcloud dashboard.
info.description:
Nextcloud integration app for Njordium Inspect360.
Sign in with your Inspect360 email and password from Personal Settings → Connected accounts. The app exchanges your credentials for a JWT refresh token (stored encrypted via Nextcloud's ICrypto), discards the password, and uses short-lived access tokens minted on demand for every API call.
Only Inspect360 accounts without multi-factor authentication are supported in this release — accounts with MFA enforced, password-change-required, or MFA-enrolment-required will see a targeted "not supported yet" message and can wait for a future release with OAuth 2.0 authorization-code flow.
The dashboard widget layer is still on the carryover shape from the fork base; Inspect360-specific widgets (Overview, Approved Vendors, Added Vendors, Assessed) are being built in the next release.
info.author: Kim Haverblad
